{"diagnosis": "With COMPRESSED_ISA enabled (picosoc/picosoc.v:139) the 256-word NOP fetch test traps with `TRAP: cpu trap asserted` / `FAIL 0xdead` instead of progressing. At picorv32.v:388 `mem_rdata_latched` for `mem_la_firstword` selects `mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle[31:16]` (0x0000 illegal) instead of `[15:0]` (0x0013 NOP low-half) per picorv32.v:386-387 shuffle context. This mis-shuffle injects illegal 0x0000 on aligned fetches and causes the trap.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -386,3 +386,3 @@
 	assign mem_rdata_latched = COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word ? {16'bx, mem_16bit_buffer} :
 			COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_secondword ? {mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle[15:0], mem_16bit_buffer} :
-			COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_firstword ? {16'bx, mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle[31:16]} : mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle;
+			COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_firstword ? {16'bx, mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle[15:0]} : mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle;", "expected": "tohost: PASS (no TRAP: cpu trap asserted, fetch progress OK)"}
